title: CerebralHelm Model Profile Catalog
description: Which model serves each capability profile, how much context it may allocate, and how long it stays resident (ADR-009). Product logic addresses profiles; exact model ids are resolved here so that no named local model becomes an architectural dependency. Optional: with no such file the app runs exactly as it does today, with no model attached.

residentBudgetGigabytes.description: Advisory only, never enforced: how much model weight this machine can hold resident before it swaps. Measured at ~48 GB on the target Mac (default GPU allocation); two resident 30B models came to ~51 GB and drove 18 GB of swap. Recorded so the figure is not rediscovered the hard way.

id.description: The capability profile product logic asks for. 'local' is not a capability but a policy: a surface that must never leave this machine even if a cloud escape hatch is later enabled.

modelId.description: The runtime's own tag for the model, e.g. 'qwen3.6:35b-mlx'.

runtimeId.description: Which inference runtime serves it — 'ollama', 'llama.cpp', 'mlx'. A pattern rather than an enum so adding a runtime is a config change, not a schema change.

contextTokens.description: Context window to allocate. A memory lever, not only a capability one: left unset a runtime allocates the model's full advertised window (131K/262K), which took a 21 GB model to 29 GB resident. Capping to 16K recovered ~6 GB.

residency.description: pinned for an always-on surface, where a ~70 s cold reload would be felt every time; evictAfterUse for a rare specialist that would otherwise hold tens of gigabytes.

residencyIdleSeconds.description: Required when residency is 'bounded', and rejected otherwise.

thinking.description: Whether the model may deliberate. Off everywhere except deep research: composition from a typed snapshot is rendering, not reasoning, and leaving it on cost 79-130 s against 9-17 s.

timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock budget for one request. Defaults to 120 when absent.

residentGigabytes.description: Advisory estimate of this model's resident footprint, counted once per distinct model id. An owner-maintained figure that drifts with quantisation; never enforced.
